data.name: Create in world tooltip
data.value: Creates the type two tiles in front of the character with the game's own call. Its owner is a copy of the character that follows it, so the type's code cannot change the character. Each click creates it once more. It needs a character in a map.

data.name: Repeat preview tooltip
data.value: Creates the type again shortly after what it created has ended.

data.name: Mute sounds tooltip
data.value: While the preview runs, the game starts no sound effects. Music, looped sounds and sounds already playing go on.

data.name: Sprite every frame
data.value: A sprite lasts one frame; the preview creates it again every frame.

data.name: World not in game
data.value: Creating in the world needs a character in a map.

data.name: World effects off
data.value: All effects are off in the options, so the game creates no particles and sprites.

data.name: World effects hidden
data.value: Effects are hidden in the Dev Editor, so they are not drawn.

data.name: World nothing created
data.value: The game's call created nothing: the type may need a target, a skill or a state of the character, the effects may be off in the options, or its pool is full.

data.name: World ended at once
data.value: What the call created ended in its first frame: the type may need a target, a skill or other call values.

data.name: World refused
data.value: The code of this type with this SubType changes the character or tells the server (the catapult stones knock the character back, the class change stops it, the Lagul writes into its owner), so the preview does not create it.

data.name: Call distance tooltip
data.value: How far in front of the character the call starts the type; 0 is where it stands.

data.name: Call size tooltip
data.value: The scale of the call; 0 takes the create function's default (effects 0.9, particles and sprites 1, lightning 10).

data.name: Call colour tooltip
data.value: Lightning: the call passes the light as its colour. Most of the game's calls pass none; some types then choose their colour by SubType.

data.name: Call target none tooltip
data.value: No game call creates this type with this SubType without an owner, and its code may need one.

data.name: Call target none no sources
data.value: The game's calls could not be read (the sources were not found), so None is not offered.

data.name: Call pk tooltip
data.value: Some lightning SubTypes read their lifetime and speed from PK and SkillIndex.

data.name: Game calls not found
data.value: The sources of the game the editor was built from were not found, so the game's calls cannot be listed.

data.name: No game calls
data.value: The game's code does not create this type by its name.

data.name: World no character near
data.value: No monster or NPC stands near the character, so the copy of the character is the target.

data.name: World own place
data.value: The type's code moved what it created away from where the call put it, so it is not exactly at the Distance and Height set.

data.name: World follows owner
data.value: What the type created moves to its owner, so it shows at the target, not at Distance and Height.

data.name: World own size
data.value: The type's code changes the size the call gives it, so what it created does not have exactly the Size set.

data.name: World own light
data.value: The type's code changes the light the call gives it, so what it created does not have exactly the Light set.
